display.title: Summer Vacation: Torah, Davening and Tzedakah Every Day
display.summary_short: Before summer vacation, Uncle Yossi reminds children to learn Torah, daven and give tzedakah every day, and to pack a siddur, Chumash and pushka.
display.summary_long: A short summer talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. As children prepare for summer vacation, Uncle Yossi asks them to set aside time every day for three important things: learning Torah, davening and giving tzedakah, Torah, avodah and gemilus chasadim. The Sages teach in Pirkei Avos that the existence of the whole world depends on these three. By doing them every day, even putting a few coins into a tzedakah box, we do our share in keeping the world going, and Hashem will bless us with a pleasant and safe vacation, good health and happiness for the whole family. He reminds them to pack a siddur, a Chumash and other holy books such as Tanach, Tehillim and Shulchan Aruch, and a tzedakah pushka so they can give every day while away.
display.lesson: Even on vacation, learn Torah, daven and give tzedakah every day: the world stands on these three things.

sources_cited.note: The world stands on Torah, avodah and gemilus chasadim.
